import { Command } from "commander";
import { watchQueue } from "./queue";
import { streamLogs } from "./logs";
import { loadConfig } from "./config";
import { createPreview, type PreviewOptions } from "./preview";

const program = new Command();

program
  .name("widget")
  .description("Watch your build queue from the terminal")
  .version("0.5.0");

program
  .command("watch")
  .description("Follow the queue and refresh every 2 seconds")
  .option("-i, --interval <seconds>", "refresh interval", "2")
  .action(async (opts) => {
    const config = await loadConfig();
    await watchQueue({ ...config, interval: Number(opts.interval) });
  });

program
  .command("logs <job>")
  .description("Stream the logs of a job")
  .action(async (job: string) => {
    await streamLogs(job);
  });

program
  .command("preview <job>")
  .description("Render a job's output in a side panel")
  .option("-f, --follow", "keep streaming new output", false)
  .option("--width <columns>", "panel width in columns", "60")
  .action(async (job: string, opts: { follow: boolean; width: string }) => {
    const options: PreviewOptions = { job, follow: opts.follow, width: Number(opts.width) };
    const preview = createPreview(options);
    preview.on("line", (line: string) => process.stdout.write(`${line}\n`));
    await preview.done;
  });

program.parseAsync(process.argv).catch((error: Error) => {
  console.error(error.message);
  process.exitCode = 1;
});
